It is a simple file system that allows users to perform basic file operations such as navigating directories, creating files and directories, reading and writing to files, etc. Tool description: Display the last part of a file of any extension. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

file_name.description: The name of the file to display. No path is allowed and you can only perform on file at local directory.

lines.description: The number of lines to display from the end of the file. Defaults to 10.

last_lines.description: The last part of the file.

function.name: touch
function.description: This tool belongs to the Gorilla file system. It is a simple file system that allows users to perform basic file operations such as navigating directories, creating files and directories, reading and writing to files, etc. Tool description: Create a new file of any extension in the current directory. file_name.description: The name of the new file in the current directory. file_name is local to the current directory and does not allow path.

mode.description: Mode of operation ('l' for lines, 'w' for words, 'c' for characters).

count.description: The count of the number of lines, words, or characters in the file.

type.description: The type of unit we are counting. [Enum]: ["lines", "words", "characters"]
